# Known vulnerabilities in the pinned runtime dependencies, triaged 2026-09-25.
#
# CI runs pip-audit against requirements.txt and ignores exactly these IDs, so
# the build stays green on today's backlog but goes red the day a NEW advisory
# lands on anything we ship. This list is debt, not a waiver: every line is
# fixed by the dependency upgrade in docs/TESTING.md ("Dependency upgrade"),
# and a line is deleted when its package moves past the fixed version.
#
# Format: one ID per line; everything after '#' is a note.

PYSEC-2024-38     # fastapi 0.109.0 -> 0.109.1 (multipart ReDoS, CVE-2024-24762)
PYSEC-2026-1850   # python-multipart 0.0.6 -> 0.0.7 (same ReDoS)
PYSEC-2026-1851   # python-multipart -> 0.0.18 (CVE-2024-53981, DoS)
PYSEC-2026-1852   # python-multipart -> 0.0.22
PYSEC-2026-3036   # python-multipart -> 0.0.30
PYSEC-2026-3037   # python-multipart -> 0.0.30
PYSEC-2026-3038   # python-multipart -> 0.0.26
PYSEC-2026-3039   # python-multipart -> 0.0.27
PYSEC-2026-3040   # python-multipart -> 0.0.31
PYSEC-2026-1943   # starlette 0.35.1 -> 0.40.0 (multipart DoS, CVE-2024-47874)
PYSEC-2026-1941   # starlette -> 0.47.2 (CVE-2025-54121)
PYSEC-2026-161    # starlette -> 1.0.1
PYSEC-2026-2280   # starlette -> 1.1.0
PYSEC-2026-2281   # starlette -> 1.1.0
PYSEC-2026-248    # starlette -> 1.3.0
PYSEC-2026-249    # starlette -> 1.3.1
PYSEC-2024-232    # python-jose 3.3.0 -> 3.4.0 (algorithm confusion). Mitigated: we
                  # decode with algorithms=[HS256] only, pinned by tests/security/test_tokens.py
PYSEC-2024-233    # python-jose -> 3.4.0 (JWE decompression bomb; we never decode JWE)
PYSEC-2025-185    # python-jose, no fix: replace with PyJWT in the upgrade
PYSEC-2026-1325   # ecdsa (python-jose dependency), no fix; we sign HS256, never ECDSA
PYSEC-2026-1433   # gunicorn 21.2.0 -> 22.0.0 (request smuggling; uvicorn serves, nginx in front)
PYSEC-2026-1434   # gunicorn -> 22.0.0
PYSEC-2026-1917   # sentry-sdk 1.39.1 -> 1.45.1 (env leak to subprocesses)
PYSEC-2026-1805   # protobuf 4.25.9 -> 5.29.6 (via firebase-admin / google libs)
PYSEC-2026-2338   # aiosmtplib 2.0.2 -> 5.1.1 (via fastapi-mail)
PYSEC-2026-3805   # aiosmtplib -> 5.1.2
